report: Checked all 16 candidate lemmas and read the dump end to end for added-unit splits. No construction is analysed two ways: the refrain verses 2 and 6 are aligned identically (twice-realized הוּא under rule 25, copula on the nominal predicate, מִשְׂגָּב → is high tower headed on high), and every verbless clause in the chapter puts its copula or linking verb on the predicate morpheme — nominal (vv. 2, 6, 8, 9), prepositional מִן/עַל/בְּ (vv. 1, 5, 7, 9) and belonging לְ → belongeth unto (vv. 11, 12).

v1 vs v5: דּוּמִיָּה (noun, verbless clause) → waiteth added + in silence on the noun under rule 33, while דּוֹמִּי (imperative) → wait thou in silence whole on the verb under rule 44. Different morphology licenses the difference; not a split. v1 cometh read as rule 20's linking verb (come is in that rule's list) and joins מִן exactly as v5's is from does.

Connectives: every waw takes the word the ASV wrote (but/And/Also/and); the two coordinators the Hebrew juxtaposes (v7 and my refuge, v9 and men of high degree) are added under rule 14; the repeated like of v3 is the one כְּ's distributed occurrence under rule 25 with the rule-33 alternative noted. v9 lighter kept on the comparative מִן with the added alternative noted; single occurrence, no chapter-wide bearing.

BSB disagreements (v3 attributive article before tottering, v4 suffix inside the inwardly fusion, v9 לַ before a finite-recast infinitive, v12 lexicalized suffix of אֲדֹנָי) are all documented convention differences (rules 29/47, 40, 52, 57); none is an error.
The two repeated notes flagged by the validator restate rules 20 and 49 and need no convention entry. Nothing here generalises beyond what the contract already says; no promotion or amendment.
